patches.name: Block analytics & tracking
patches.description: Stops Amazon's Minerva metrics uploads and Firebase/Google Analytics in the Prime Video phone app. Crash reporting, sign-in and playback are left alone. Opt-in / experimental; test on-device.

patches.name: Disable auto-updates
patches.description: Stops the Play Store from silently replacing the patched app with the official version, which would bring the ads back. It raises the app's version number far ahead of the Store's, so the Store sees it as up to date. You can still update on purpose by patching a newer version.

patches.name: Hide device identifiers
patches.description: Gives the app a random per-install Android ID instead of your device's, and reports a zeroed advertising ID with ad tracking limited, as if you had deleted your ad ID in Android settings. The video DRM ID is left alone so playback works. Opt-in / experimental; test on-device.

patches.name: Hide VPN connection
patches.description: Hides an active VPN from the app's on-device checks, so it sees the network the VPN runs over. The app can still tell from your IP address on its servers. Opt-in / experimental; test on-device.

patches.name: Report Wi-Fi connection
patches.description: Makes the app see an unmetered Wi-Fi connection when the phone is on mobile data, so Wi-Fi-only downloads and quality limits do not apply. This can use a lot of mobile data. Opt-in / experimental; test on-device.

patches.name: Skip ads
patches.description: Plays every Prime Video title in the phone app's older player and gives it Amazon's own empty ad plan, so no ad break is scheduled. The newer player's features, such as its X-Ray views, are not available. The stream request is not changed.

patches.name: Spoof carrier
patches.description: Hides your mobile carrier from the app and the ad and analytics SDKs inside it, or reports a carrier name you choose. Carrier deals the app detects from your carrier will not work while this is on. Opt-in / experimental; test on-device.

options.description: The carrier name the app sees. Pick one from the list or type any name. Blank hides the carrier.
